journey: dashboard document list -> authorized download -> repository upload -> persisted canonical row -> download audit -> UI refresh

canonicalContractGaps.detail: No canonical share, member disclosure, export, or WorkAid counsel route. The console fails closed. Do not implement sharing as a privacy-label PATCH.
canonicalContractGaps.integratorNote: Sharing, member disclosure, export and counsel disclosure remain separate governed actions that are not implemented. Every surface fails closed. They need an institutional disclosure policy (who may disclose what, to whom, with consent) before an action can be authorised; viewing, downloading and processing never imply them.

canonicalContractGaps.detail: No canonical document retention contract or per-document legal-hold record exists (legal_holds is scoped by data type and date range, not by document). The console presents hold and retention status as unavailable and offers no save, release or execute action. A privacy label is never a hold. Metadata flags that the versioning guard reads are not an authoritative hold record.
canonicalContractGaps.integratorNote: No per-document legal-hold or retention-execution record exists. Hold status is shown as unavailable and no release or execute action exists. Needs the institutional retention contract.

canonicalContractGaps.detail: Resolved. The route no longer calls appendMandatoryAudit. All downloads go through lib/documents/download-issuance.ts, which calls persistAtomicAudit: it records the access (hash-chained under Canonical V2, audit_logs otherwise) or throws, and has no "skipped" result. A URL is issued only after the record is written. Proven against PostgreSQL semantics with V2 on and off, with injected audit faults.

tranche2ContractGaps.behavior: POST /api/documents/repository must append a mandatory document-create audit for every accepted row. Today auditCaseMutation runs only when linkedEntityType is grievance.
tranche2ContractGaps.security: An unlinked OCR intake can persist a classified document with no durable create audit. Cursor must not add a second audit writer on the protected route.
tests: repository create audit assertion for an unlinked document, including audit failure rolling back the row
tranche2ContractGaps.resolution: POST /api/documents/repository audits every create (linked or not) with persistAtomicAudit in the same transaction as the document, its first version, its link and the intake binding. An audit that cannot be written rolls all of it back. The legacy upload route uses the same atomic audit.

tranche2ContractGaps.behavior: Add a governed transcript write that keeps six records distinct: immutable original bytes, raw machine text, human-reviewed transcription, reviewer identity and timestamp, transcription revisions, and published evidence. The write needs explicit authority, optimistic concurrency, provenance, classification at least as strong as the source, and a mandatory audit in the same transaction.
tranche2ContractGaps.security: Reject unauthorized corrections, cross-document ids, stale revisions, and audit failure without changing the document. Do not copy OCR text into contentText or grievance evidence. No shadow table. The upload screen stays fail-closed until this contract exists.
tests: authorized correction persists as a distinct transcript; unauthorized, cross-tenant, and audit-failure writes leave the document unchanged
tranche2ContractGaps.resolution: document_transcript_revisions (append-only machine extraction, human draft and human-reviewed revisions with provenance, reviewer identity, classification, contiguous revisions and optimistic concurrency) and document_transcript_publications (a separate, once-only publication as evidence of the head reviewed revision), written by lib/documents/transcripts.ts with mandatory audit. The original document version is never changed.

tranche2ContractGaps.behavior: Decide whether a member who already passes isDocumentVisibleByPolicy may request OCR. The route currently requires steward before that policy runs.
tranche2ContractGaps.security: Do not infer OCR rights from role seniority alone. A member grant or case assignment should be explicit if the steward minimum is relaxed.
tests: member with document visibility is allowed only after the contract change; unassigned and foreign callers stay denied
tranche2ContractGaps.resolution: Processing is its own authority (lib/documents/ocr-authority.ts): the kernel case:process_ocr on a live case relationship, an explicit can_process_ocr grant, or the uploader under an ADOPTED institutional member policy. Role seniority and the legacy representative-identifier column are not inputs. No member policy is adopted by default; adopting one is an institutional decision.

tranche2ContractGaps.behavior: appendMandatoryAudit returns false when UE_CANONICAL_BOOTSTRAP_V2 is not 1. The OCR route now withholds extracted text when the helper throws or returns false. The helper is unchanged.
tranche2ContractGaps.security: OCR text is unavailable until canonical audit is enabled and the insert succeeds. Document download keeps its existing helper contract. Cursor does not fork the helper.
tests: V2 enabled writes document.ocr.extract without the extracted text; V2 disabled and a thrown audit write each return 503 and no text under the doc_runtime role
tranche2ContractGaps.resolution: OCR extraction audits through persistAtomicAudit in the transaction that stores the machine revision; the text is withheld when the write or the audit fails.

tranche2ContractGaps.behavior: Image and PDF extraction call processImageOCR or processPDFOCR after an organization-prefixed downloadBuffer. Byte signatures override a lying MIME. Unsupported containers return 501. Processor and storage failures return 502 and no text.
tranche2ContractGaps.security: No successful OCR result is manufactured when the processor, blob credentials, or callback is unavailable. Temporary text is not written to contentText. Live tesseract and blob credentials are still an operations dependency.
tests: live processor fixture with organization-scoped blob bytes; provider failure returns 502 and writes no contentText
tranche2ContractGaps.integratorNote: Real OCR bytes against a live processor and object store have not been exercised. Prerequisite: a non-production environment with the processor and blob credentials, and a corpus of approved test files.

tranche2ContractGaps.behavior: Add an authoritative intake record with a server-generated unpredictable id bound to the principal, organization, exact object key, checksum, content type, size, createdAt, expiresAt, and state open|accepted|expired|cancelled. Cancellation is limited to that principal or a cleanup service. Refuse a key referenced by a document or document version. Flip state in the same transaction before deleteBlob of the stored key only. Record create, accept, expire, and delete audits. A cleanup job expires abandoned open intakes. Replay is idempotent.
tranche2ContractGaps.security: Until that table exists, POST /api/documents/upload returns 403 for any discardBlobPath and does not call deleteBlob. Legacy upload without the field still inserts. canonicalIntake still stores an object. A failed repository create can leave an orphan. Cursor must not add a shadow table or migration.
tests: same-organization cross-user deletion, attached objects, forged identifiers, replay, parallel races, expired intake, foreign tenants, and cleanup failure against the intake table
tranche2ContractGaps.resolution: document_intakes (open to accepted, expired or cancelled) bound to the principal, organization, exact server-issued storage key, server checksum, MIME type, size, timestamps and intended operation. Acceptance binds atomically with the document or version; an accepted object can never be cancelled or deleted; abandoned uploads are expired and their exact objects deleted by a retrying reaper. Request and response contract: POST /api/documents/intakes (or /api/documents/upload with canonicalIntake=1) returns { success, data: { intakeId, status, operation, targetDocumentId, filename, mimeType, size, checksum, createdAt, expiresAt } } and never a storage path; POST /api/documents/repository and /api/documents/repository/[id]/versions take intakeId; POST /api/documents/intakes/[id]/cancel cancels.

tranche2ContractGaps.behavior: getEffectiveCaseAccess must return relationship status active|revoked|expired|recused even when unionRepId matches the actor, plus canProcessOcr distinct from canViewCase, canUploadDocuments, and a document view grant. Viewing, downloading, OCR extraction, transcript correction, and evidence publication stay separate decisions.
tranche2ContractGaps.security: The OCR route does not treat steward seniority as case access. Linked extraction currently requires primary ownership or canUploadDocuments because canProcessOcr does not exist. Revoked and expired assignments are denied because the kernel returns canViewCase false. Recusal of a primary owner cannot be represented until the kernel reports it. Do not add the enum in this tranche.
tests: unassigned, revoked, expired, recused primary owner, foreign organization, member, view-only assignment, and privileged document without classification authority
tranche2ContractGaps.resolution: The kernel action case:process_ocr (effective permission canProcessOcr), distinct from view, upload and download, resolved from relationship status, document classification, recusal, expiry and valid document grants.

tranche3ContractGaps.integratorNote: No provider credentials were used. Prerequisite: sandbox provider accounts, signed webhook secrets and an approved test envelope set. Status handling is implemented and proven without a provider (lib/signature/signature-sync.pglite.test.ts).

tranche3ContractGaps.behavior: SharePoint healthCheck returns an error before any network call when client id, secret, or tenant id is missing. Live Graph sync is not activated.
tranche3ContractGaps.security: Do not report a successful sync without credentials and a recorded provider response.
tranche3ContractGaps.integratorNote: Needs tenant, client id and secret for a non-production SharePoint site.

tranche3ContractGaps.behavior: DocumentsConsole.handleBulkDownload still opens permitted URLs before a later denial and returns. That file is tranche 1 and was not edited. The portal DocumentBrowser uses authorizeBulkDownload and reports partial outcomes.
tranche3ContractGaps.security: Do not describe the staff console bulk action as an atomic batch. Do not rewrite the tranche 1 console in this tranche.
tranche3ContractGaps.resolution: The console calls POST /api/documents/repository/downloads, which authorizes and audits per document and reports partial success; only issued links are opened.

tranche3ContractGaps.behavior: External download no longer returns documents.fileUrl. A missing version storage key returns 404. A present key still calls generateSasUrl. Live blob credentials were not exercised.
tranche3ContractGaps.security: The SAS URL is an authorized retrieval reference, not a list-field leak. Provider failure must not fall back to the stored file address.
tranche3ContractGaps.integratorNote: Audit-before-link is proven against PostgreSQL with the authorization chain stood in. Live blob credentials have not been exercised.

qualificationContractGaps.behavior: GET /api/external/documents/[id]/download calls authorizeExternalDocumentAccess, selects the latest documentVersions.storageKey for that organization and document, then calls generateSasUrl. withExternalMatterResourceAuth and the route write no audit row. appendMandatoryAudit is not called.
qualificationContractGaps.correction: Add a canonical external-download audit that records the actor, organizationId, matterType, matterId, documentId, and version identity, and withhold the SAS URL when that write throws or returns false. Do not store the SAS URL or documents.fileUrl in the audit payload. Do not fall back to fileUrl. appendMandatoryAudit returns false when UE_CANONICAL_BOOTSTRAP_V2 is not 1. Choose that helper or a matter-scoped audit that stays durable when V2 is off. Cursor will not edit lib/audit/mandatory-audit.ts.
qualificationContractGaps.resolution: GET /api/external/documents/[id]/download records principal, representative organization, authority, matter grant, matter, document and version durably with persistAtomicAudit before the link is returned. The link and its signature are never recorded; the link is withheld when the audit or signing fails.

qualificationContractGaps.behavior: SignatureService.syncDocumentStatus sets completedAt to the local clock when a provider status is completed. The projection labels a stored completed row as historical_evidence unless providerAcknowledgedAt is already present. verified_completed is not created from that local clock.
qualificationContractGaps.correction: Persist the provider completion timestamp and provider event id on the signature row. Do not treat a locally stamped completedAt as a verified provider acknowledgment.
qualificationContractGaps.resolution: SignatureService.syncDocumentStatus judges a provider report with decideProviderSync: only external providers report, terminal states are final, observations move forward only, and a completion time is the provider's own event time (provider_acknowledged_at, immutable, platform 0023) or none; the local receipt time is kept separately as provider_status_observed_at. The change, signer updates and audit commit together and are conditional on the judged status, so a replay or concurrent sync applies once.

integratorResolutions.resolution: A legacy row is served only if its file URL validates as a reference into this organization's own storage (host, container, organization folder, no relative segments) and is re-signed from the verified path; a stored external or foreign URL is never returned. lib/documents/legacy-storage-backfill.ts and POST /api/admin/documents/legacy-backfill give verified legacy rows a real version and report the rest.

POST /api/documents/repository/downloads: per-document authorization and audit, per-document outcomes, atomic:false. The console reports partial success and opens only issued links. The old sequential stop-on-first-failure loop is gone.

resolveStoredBlob accepts only this organization's own storage references, computes the SHA-256 itself, and rejects a claimed hash that differs (409). Versions refuse a stale expectedVersionNo, a file another version already holds, a deleted document, and a legal hold re-read under a row lock. The console no longer invents a "manual:" hash and no longer offers external URL import.
Legal hold and retention figures are unavailable (null), not derived from privacy labels; no simulated release, execute or save.

document_intakes (open to accepted, expired or cancelled) bound to the principal, organization, exact server-issued storage key, server checksum, MIME type, size, timestamps and intended operation. Acceptance binds atomically with the document or version; an accepted object can never be cancelled or deleted; abandoned uploads are expired and their exact objects deleted by a retrying reaper. Request and response contract: POST /api/documents/intakes (or /api/documents/upload with canonicalIntake=1) returns { success, data: { intakeId, status, operation, targetDocumentId, filename, mimeType, size, checksum, createdAt, expiresAt } } and never a storage path; POST /api/documents/repository and /api/documents/repository/[id]/versions take intakeId; POST /api/documents/intakes/[id]/cancel cancels.

Canonical OCR processing authority (case:process_ocr / can_process_ocr), machine and human-reviewed transcript revisions kept apart from the immutable original, evidence publication as a separate act. Cursor's parallel lib/documents/ocr-authorization.ts was removed; the OCR route, transcript routes and the upload consumer use the canonical modules.

GET /api/external/documents/[id]/download records principal, representative organization, authority, matter grant, matter, document and version durably with persistAtomicAudit before the link is returned. The link and its signature are never recorded; the link is withheld when the audit or signing fails.

The change, signer updates and audit commit together and are conditional on the judged status, so a replay or concurrent sync applies once.
